intro.title: Shaligram
intro.descriptionHtml: Presenting different Shaligram products, consisting of Shaligram Shala, Shaligram idols, Shaligram Rings, Bracelets, and Malas, made from natural Shaligram stone. The Shaligram is a very powerful sacred stone representing Lord Vishnu and found in the Gandaki Kali River in Nepal. You can install, wear, and worship the Shaligram to garner the blessings of Lord Vishnu and His Avatars. Lord Vishnu is the preserver and protector of the Universe and blesses with good fortune, overall happiness, good health and liberates from sins.
